holds_without_pictures_note: Measured on scratch copies of shop1 and school1 with every photograph removed (media.photos, catalogue and step pictures): shots clean at 1440 and 390, legible ok (485 / 1549 line readings), picture share 0. The first screen becomes a 75vh ground block with the name and the h1; the card row is left out; the shop grid, rows and foot stand as type. It holds as a plain priced list, but this template is chosen for a client whose products have their own pictures.

picture_share_case: shop1: page 8,420 px, under 1.5x the reference's 10,098, overall share compared: 47 % vs 45 % — passes. school1: page 14,678 px (1.45x), so by the letter the overall share applies: 21 % vs 45 % — under by 24. Over the screens both pages have (without the shop, people and credentials) about 51 % vs 46 %. All four wide pictures of the reference are in place and in order. school1 has no further photograph of 1100x400 or more (14 of its 18 are 450x338), so no band can break its 46 courses.
